text:
maria (eng-platform): Heads-up: planning v9 SDK rollout TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke owners, and rollback readiness. Plan: EU region first, canary 10% for 30m, promote to 50% for 1h, then 100% if all green.

ben (eng-runtime): I can own the deploy. I’ll push tag v9.0.0-rc2 -> release if canary looks good. ETA start 09:00 PT. Who will run the smoke script?

tara (eng-sre): I’ll run smoke & metrics. My checklist: 
- run canary test suite (smoke-api.sh)
- validate p95 < 150ms for text-gen endpoints
- check token usage / errors (4xx/5xx)
- trace a couple of long tails with tracing UI
I’ll post results in this thread.

sam (client-success): I’ll prepare a short customer-facing note ready to send after canary green. Can someone paste the changelog blurb + migration notes?

maria (eng-platform): Copy for comms: "v9 improves batching & reduces CPU on short-context calls. No breaking auth changes; new optional header X-Client-Source supported. Recommend upgrading but old SDKs will continue to work."
Add migration snippet: "switch to new client constructor to enable auto-batching: new Redwood({autoBatch: true})"

ben (eng-runtime): Deploy plan (high-level):
1) deploy v9 image to canary pool in eu-west-1
2) set canary weight 10% for 30m
3) run smoke suite against canary endpoints
4) if green -> increase to 50% for 60m, run perf tests
5) if green -> ramp to 100% over 30m
6) monitor, rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 regression > 20%

maria (eng-platform): Rollback commands (K8s):
```bash
# rollback to last stable
kubectl set image deployment/sdk-api sdk-api=redwood/sdk:v8.9.4 -n production
kubectl rollout status deployment/sdk-api -n production
```
Feature-flag name: `sdk_v9_enabled` — we can flip it per customer if needed.

tara (eng-sre): I’ll run these smoke commands after canary deploy:
```bash
./scripts/smoke-api.sh --target=https://canary.api.redwood.ai --token=$SMOKE_TOKEN
# tests: auth, gen basic, embed, streaming
```
I’ll attach short grep-able summary: failures/total, avg latency, p95.

ben (eng-runtime): deploy-bot will post once canary image is live. deploy-bot: please tag canary image in the thread.

deploy-bot: canary image redwood/sdk:v9.0.0-rc2 pushed to eu-west-1 at 2026-06-12T08:58:10Z :rocket:

maria (eng-platform): One more ask: compatibility tests — @ben can you run compatibility matrix vs v8 clients (node/python/java) in the staging env pre-deploy? quick pass only (~15m). If anything fails we hold.

ben (eng-runtime): Yep will run node/python/java smoke wrappers. If any auth or payload schema regression -> hold and hotfix.

sam (client-success): For the customer note: short blurb + link to migration docs would be great. I’ll draft and queue for approval after canary green.

maria (eng-platform): Post-deploy metrics to watch (please monitor dashboards):
- overall error rate (4xx/5xx),
- latency p50/p95,
- token/sec per instance,
- queue length/backpressure signs
If any of these exceed thresholds, we roll back.

tara (eng-sre): I’ll be live in #eng-platform during rollout and will ping if anything looks off. If I don’t ping, assume green. :thumbsup:

ben (eng-runtime): I’ll start deploy at 09:00 PT. tagging me as deploy owner. If we need to abort early, I’ll run rollback commands and post status here.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. Final checklist for tomorrow morning:
- ben: deploy owner (09:00 PT)
- tara: smoke owner (run smoke, post results)
- sam: client comms draft ready
- maria: rollback plan & feature flag ready
We’ll reconvene in-thread for green/hold decisions.

sam (client-success): Received. I’ll have draft ready by +2h pre-deploy.

ben (eng-runtime): All set on my side. See you all in the channel.
